expectations.text: Output does not force an artificial steelman/critique structure onto what is fundamentally a recommendation request
expectations.evidence: Opens with 'Trả lời thẳng: ... cứ thử 5x trước, đừng nhảy thẳng lên 20x' — a direct recommendation, no steelman/counterpoint/risk-if-wrong ceremony.

expectations.text: Output addresses the actual question (5x vs 20x plan choice, and whether current usage would max out those limits) rather than producing an unrelated critique
expectations.evidence: Directly compares 5x vs 20x, explains the mechanism, and gives a concrete self-check method (when Pro limit gets hit during the week).

expectations.text: Output either answers helpfully or asks a clarifying question about missing info instead of fabricating a critique-shaped response
expectations.evidence: Gives a working default recommendation (try 5x, monitor, upgrade if still maxing out) plus a genuinely useful caveat (Opus vs Sonnet quota) — not critique-shaped.
